Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. It lets you save your favorite filters, sorts, and groupings so you never have to rebuild the same list twice. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, sprint progress, or a custom workflow view, you can capture the exact setup you rely on and return to it in one click.

Each team member can save up to 50 personalized views, giving everyone room to organize work exactly the way they think about it. Need a colleague to see the same slice of data you do? Views can be shared with your team, so everyone works from a consistent, up-to-date picture without repeating setup steps. This makes standups, reviews, and reporting faster, since the right view is always just a click away.

Saved Views rolls out automatically, with no configuration required and no extra cost for eligible plans. We think it will quickly become part of your daily routine.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
